agent_review.author: agent

findings.summary: Eelektrik triggered a sacrificial relay: Bushtank switched in, then Coppertop switched in and fainted, then Ohmnomnom entered and fainted before Croakatoa finished it.

resolution.observed: Policy v12 requires a slower voluntary replacement to survive both the entry hit and the next hit before calling it safe. Exact turn-011 replay now vetoes every switch as unsafe; exact turn-015 replay selects Razor Leaf and vetoes Coppertop rather than continuing the relay.

findings.summary: The win preserved only Bushtank at 6 HP and Birdlaw at 44 HP; the corrected line must materially reduce the four allied faints.
The fight used 28 actions and 7 switches; 4 switches were forced replacements after faints, while 3 were voluntary.

correct_choices: All 28 actions and the terminal win were verified from authoritative emulator state.
Lildozer and Croakatoa made priority progress before their forced replacements.
Birdlaw finished Sunflora and Dustox without an extra switch.
agent_review.next_test: Restart Clone 1 with policy v12 and require no false-safe voluntary switch plus materially fewer allied faints.
